newsitem.title: USA: Cable/Wireless forms carrier services unit.
newsitem.headline: Cable/Wireless forms carrier services unit.

text.p: Cable & Wireless Plc said Wednesday it has formed a new business unit to coordinate marketing of its worldwide networks to other carriers and operators for wholesale delivery of international traffic.
The new carrier services unit targets business with second-tier carriers, new service providers and cellular operators in areas served by Cable & Wireless companies, it said.
By routing traffic to the nearest Cable & Wireless gateway, those entities will be able to have their traffic delivered worldwide simply and cost-effectively, it said.
Cable & Wireless is a London-based company that provides mobile communications in 30 countries and operates the world's largest cableship fleet.
